text:
My eyes do not seek you over the immense earth!

you are my eyes dilating.

My eyes contain you; if you weep through them,

it is I who free myself from myself so that you may weep.


How you I am with myself, love; how you alienate me!

How mine your living and how mine your death,

coming to you from me, dying myself with you!


The weave of beating in a body that is not yours,

nor mine alone: a body of two beings

that fuse the unity of two who are already one.

translation.title: Identification
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Conde's intense identity exchange and the shared two-in-one body.
